citations.title: The Illusion Of External Solutions For Inner Crises
Free Will or Divine Plan? Unbelievable Answer | Mastering Life: Aspirations, Balance & Inner Growth

response.response:
Self-judgment and the inner wall of defense often stem from comparison and the fear of external judgment. Sri Preethaji & Sri Krishnaji teach that the fuel we use to aspire—often comparison and self-judgment—is corrosive and hinders our growth. Instead, they suggest shifting to a "Beautiful State" where you aspire not out of fear or comparison, but out of genuine love for what you wish to achieve. 

As Sri Preethaji & Sri Krishnaji explain, "You need to Aspire and really fall in love with what you want to do, not by comparing yourself or judging yourself with what others are thinking of me." This shift in focus allows you to dissolve the inner wall of defense and heal self-judgment by aligning with your true aspirations rather than external expectations.

To further support this transformation, a Serene Mind meditation can help you settle into this Beautiful State, allowing you to connect deeply with your aspirations and release the need for comparison or self-judgment.

If this feels heavy, you don't have to carry it alone. You can talk to someone now: India Tele-MANAS 14416 / 1800-891-4416 · United States 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline 988 · United Kingdom Samaritans 116 123. In an emergency, call 112 (India) or your local number.
